text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Victory is my destiny! What truly 
exquisite vintage wine! If paradise 
exists, it is here! Let us contest again! 
The Goddess of Fate? You must be breathing 
a sigh of relief with the Goddess of 
History.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yet I shall not cease this destruction. 
All for the sake of creation. Against 
reason, a new myth is required. Come—let 
us raise this celebratory toast together.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
For the future someone dreamed of, and 
that everyone dreams of. —Cheers!
